product_one_liner.value: Envoy provides a workplace management platform for facilities, security and IT teams to manage visitors, emergencies, resource booking, digital signage and onsite workplace insights.

pricing_page.notes: Public plans include an Enterprise tier with custom pricing.

named_customers.notes: Envoy explicitly identifies both as customers and links their case studies.

employee_band.notes: The company profile reports 462 employees; the count's effective date is unspecified.

eng_blog.notes: Includes technical posts on building an AI threat-detection pipeline and rendering React inside Ember, published August 10 and July 16, 2026.

public_docs.notes: The public developer portal provides step-by-step guides and API documentation.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The readable board lists 23 openings, none with a qualifying AI, ML or data-science title; Senior Data Analyst does not qualify.

model_provider.value: Anthropic Claude through Amazon Bedrock, and Amazon Web Services Rekognition.
model_provider.notes: Claude supports document parsing; Rekognition supports returning-visitor detection and ID-scanning facial matching.

compliance_certs.notes: The Trust Center lists SOC 2 Type 2, ISO/IEC 27001, HIPAA and GDPR. HIPAA and GDPR are compliance claims, not standalone certifications.

last_funding.notes: Most recent dated, publicly announced round located: January 11, 2022. A 2026 funding profile also identifies it as the latest round.

raised_18mo.notes: The latest dated round located was announced in January 2022, outside the 18-month window.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: An open Mid Market Account Executive posting includes an application link.

launched_6mo.notes: Envoy launched Envoy Response on August 6, 2026, combining AI-analyzed threat intelligence and incident management.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: Envoy announced Mauricio Ramirez's appointment as Chief Revenue Officer on February 26, 2026.

crm_stack_signal.notes: The BDR posting calls SFDC, Outreach, ZoomInfo and Nooks its current stack; the AE posting names the remaining systems as preferred experience.
